# Showers For Elderly

Independent planning resource published by Aging Safely Baths.

## Core pages
- Walk-In Showers for Seniors: Options, Costs & Planning: https://showersforelderly.com/walk-in-showers-for-seniors.html
- ADA Compliant Showers: Dimensions, Types & Planning: https://showersforelderly.com/ada-compliant-showers.html
- Barrier-Free Showers: Pans, Drainage & Design Guide: https://showersforelderly.com/barrier-free-showers.html
- Tub-to-Shower Conversions for Seniors: Complete Guide: https://showersforelderly.com/tub-to-shower-conversions-for-seniors.html
- Affordable Walk-In Showers for Seniors: Cost Planning: https://showersforelderly.com/affordable-walk-in-showers-for-seniors.html
- Shower Benches for Elderly Adults: Selection Guide: https://showersforelderly.com/blog/shower-benches-for-elderly.html
- Rolling Shower Chair Guide for Seniors & Disabled Users: https://showersforelderly.com/blog/rolling-shower-chair-guide.html
- Bathroom Safety Checklist for Older Adults: https://showersforelderly.com/blog/bathroom-safety-checklist-for-older-adults.html
- Caregiver-Assisted Shower Planning Guide: https://showersforelderly.com/blog/caregiver-assisted-shower-planning.html

## Policies
- Verify live product specifications with the seller before ordering.
- A product name does not establish ADA compliance.
- One-day installation is available only for qualifying projects after review.
- Primary standards resource: https://www.ada.gov/law-and-regs/design-standards/2010-stds/
